title: Chest Guardian
html:
Chest Guardian
Ancient Relic Guardian

This page is possibly outdated and needs updating, please help us getting it up to date again.

Information on this page might be outdated, and thats why we need your help to make this page Up-to-date again!



Race: Guardian

Class:

  • Ranger
  • Fighter
  • Mage

If you are doing a Relic Search Quest, you will recognize the Relic Chests by their yellowish color. BEWARE! When you open one, a Giant Hero Guardian usually appears. They are of three types.

The Ranger Class are giants armed with guns, and they will try to back off to Ranged Weapon distance and fire at you. Apart from their normal ranged attack, they also have a Chain Lightning attack that can knock you back if it hits, and will bounce between group members.

The fighter class carry large melee weapons and have a strong attack with them. The color of the weapon clues you in to the type of attack that the little floating guys will be using. Each color weapon may appear in various forms.

1) Red (fire)

2) Blue/white (ice)

3) Golden (divine)

4) Green (poison)

The mage class seem to all use Shadow Lightning attacks. They carry a purple Pixie Duster. They are also capable of inflicting Awe attacks.

All Classes also generate a group of little floating Relics in two types: Pugilistic, which use melee attacks, and Thaumaturgic which use ranged attacks (similar to the Trophy Guardians of builds before 147). They can get in the way of your Ranged Attack. If you kill the big guy, don't relax because those little ones will still get you!

We are awaiting more reports on the Build 147 changes.
